title_en: 5th Central Library Researcher Career Mentoring Lecture 2026 (Online)
summary: Campus researchers who wish to attend the 5th Central Library Researcher Career Mentoring Lecture must first complete online pre-registration. The online lecture will be held on Wednesday, 21 October 2026, from 14:00 to 15:00. The notice text does not give the registration link or a registration deadline.
applies_to: Researchers at the university (학내 연구자) who wish to attend. Attendance is optional, but online pre-registration is mandatory for anyone who attends.
conditions: Online pre-registration is mandatory before attending the lecture.
The lecture is held online only.
steps: Complete online pre-registration before the lecture. The notice text does not give the registration link or a deadline; check the original notice or contact the department office.
Attend the online lecture on Wednesday, 21 October 2026, from 14:00 to 15:00.
translation:
5th Central Library Researcher Career Mentoring Lecture of 2026

To strengthen the research capabilities of researchers at the university and to support their paper writing, the Central Library will hold a special lecture as follows.

A. Title: [Online] 5th Central Library Researcher Career Mentoring Lecture of 2026

B. Date and time: Wednesday, 21 October 2026, 14:00–15:00

C. Content: Tips on paper publication and Open Access from an IEEE editor
- Overview of the IEEE paper submission and review process
- Best practices and tips for increasing the likelihood of publication (focusing mainly on Seoul National University cases)
- IEEE author guidelines on the use of AI-generated text
- Advantages of IEEE open access publishing and information on institutional programs
- Research strategies using the IEEE Xplore Digital Library

(The original notice skips item D.)

E. Speaker: an IEEE APAC Client Services Manager (name given in the original notice)

F. How to participate: complete online pre-registration (mandatory), then attend.

Note: The notice text does not include the registration link or a registration deadline.
